Card.description: Styled container. variant: "card" (default, elevated) | "sunk" (recessed) | "clear" (transparent). Always full width. Accepts all Stack flex params (default: direction "column"). Cards flex to share space in row/wrap layouts.

TextContent.description: Text block. Supports markdown. Optional size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy".

MarkDownRenderer.description: Renders markdown text with optional container variant

CardHeader.description: Header with optional title and subtitle

Callout.description: Callout banner. Optional visible is a reactive $boolean — auto-dismisses after 3s by setting $visible to false.

TextCallout.description: Text callout with variant, title, and description

Image.description: Image with alt text and optional URL

ImageGallery.description: Gallery grid of images with modal preview

HorizontalBarChart.description: Horizontal bars; prefer when category labels are long or for ranked lists

RadarChart.description: Spider/web chart; use for comparing multiple variables across one or more entities

PieChart.description: Circular slices; use plucked arrays: PieChart(data.categories, data.values)

RadialChart.description: Radial bars; use plucked arrays: RadialChart(data.categories, data.values)

SingleStackedBarChart.description: Single horizontal stacked bar; use plucked arrays: SingleStackedBarChart(data.categories, data.values)

ScatterChart.description: X/Y scatter plot; use for correlations, distributions, and clustering

AreaChart.description: Filled area under lines; use for cumulative totals or volume trends over time

BarChart.description: Vertical bars; use for comparing values across categories with one or more series

LineChart.description: Lines over categories; use for trends and continuous data over time

Table.description: Data table — column-oriented. Each Col holds its own data array.

Col.description: Column definition — holds label + data array

TagBlock.description: tags is an array of strings; optional size sm | md | lg

Form.description: Form container with fields and explicit action buttons

FormControl.description: Field with label, input component, and optional hint text

Slider.description: Numeric slider input; supports continuous and discrete (stepped) variants

Chips.description: A form field of compact selectable chips for choosing one or many short options; the selection is stored under `name`.

ChipItem.description: A single selectable chip inside a Chips group, with a value, label and optional icon.

Icon.description: A lucide icon by kebab-case name (e.g. 'circle-check'). Optional category picks a topical fallback when the name doesn't resolve.

OptionCards.description: A form field of selectable cards (title, optional subtitle, optional icon or image) laid out in a responsive grid for choosing one or many options; the selection is stored under `name`.

OptionCard.description: A single selectable card inside an OptionCards group, with a value, title, optional subtitle and an optional Icon or Image on top.

IconButton.description: Icon-only button. name is the accessible label and the action label; icon is an Icon; action fires on click.

StepsItem.description: title and details text for one step

InlineHeader.description: Compact section heading with an optional one-line description, for use inside cards.

EntityList.description: Two-column key/value rows (left label, right value). size 'default' supports optional header and footer rows; rightVariant 'number' uses tabular numbers.

EditableTable.description: Spreadsheet-like table whose cells the user can edit inline (text, number, url, date, select columns); edits are saved back as a form field

SnippetCardBlock.description: A responsive grid of compact label/value cards (2 per row) for showing several short facts side by side; optionally clickable with a shared action.

SnippetCardItem.description: One row-style snippet card: a label on the left (IconText or ImageText) and an optional value on the right (Text or BoldText).

IconText.description: An icon badge with a title and optional subtitle, laid out horizontally or vertically. iconVariant sets the badge color.

ImageText.description: A small square image (thumbnail/avatar) with a title and optional subtitle. src must be a real image URL.

Text.description: Plain text line with optional subtext. variant 'number' uses tabular number styling; subtextVariant 'metric' colors a leading +/- subtext green/red.

BoldText.description: Emphasized (bold) text line with optional subtext. variant 'number' uses tabular number styling; subtextVariant 'metric' colors a leading +/- subtext green/red.

OverviewCardBlock.description: A grid or horizontal carousel of compact overview cards, each with a heading (icon/image/text) on top and an inline metric below; optionally clickable with a shared action.

OverviewCardItem.description: One overview card: a heading slot at the top (IconText, ImageText or Text) and an optional MetricIndicatorInline at the bottom.

MetricIndicatorInline.description: Headline metric value with an optional +/- percentage trend and subtext, all on one line.

ContextCardBlock.description: A grid or carousel of compact tinted context cards (title or tag plus a short bold body); an optional action makes every card clickable.

ContextCardItem.description: A single card inside a ContextCardBlock: a title (plain string or Tag), an optional markdown body, and an optional gray tint or background image.

Tag.description: Styled tag/badge with optional Icon and variant

CompositeCardBlock.description: A two-per-row grid or carousel of rich cards, each with an optional header, stacked body content (text, metrics, charts, lists, tags) and a price/button footer; an optional action makes every card clickable.

CompositeCardItem.description: A single card inside a CompositeCardBlock: an optional header (icon/image/text), a stack of body elements (text, metrics, charts, lists, tags), and an optional price/button footer.

ImageTextLarge.description: A full-width banner image above a bold title and optional subtitle. src must be a real image URL.

ListBlock.description: A list of items with number or image indicators. Each item can optionally have an action. size small renders a compact list.

ListItem.description: Item in a ListBlock — displays a title with an optional subtitle and image. When action is provided, the item becomes clickable.

MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough.description: Headline metric value with an optional struck-through previousValue, a +/- percentage trend, and subtext below.

VisualCardBlock.description: A grid or carousel of photo-first cards: a full-bleed background image with a tag on top and a bold text panel at the bottom; an optional action makes every card clickable.

VisualCardItem.description: A single photo-first card inside a VisualCardBlock: a BoldText body panel, an optional Tag, and a background image (bgImageSrc must be a real URL; bgImageAlt is its alt text).

TabItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is tab label, content is array of components

Stack.description: Flex container. direction: "row"|"column" (default "column"). gap: "none"|"xs"|"s"|"m"|"l"|"xl"|"2xl" (default "m"). align: "start"|"center"|"end"|"stretch"|"baseline". justify: "start"|"center"|"end"|"between"|"around"|"evenly".

Slice.description: One slice with label and numeric value

AccordionItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is section title

Modal.description: Modal dialog. open is a reactive $boolean binding — set to true to open, X/Escape/backdrop auto-closes. Put Form with buttons inside children.

Svg.description: A drawing written as inline SVG markup (one <svg viewBox="…"> element), with an optional caption under it. Color names of the Loom palette (blue, peach, green, mauve, red, yellow, teal, text, subtext0, overlay1, surface0, …) follow the theme; shapes without a fill take the text color. Give the shapes narration will point at an id. No scripts, links, images or foreignObject.

title.description: Page title used in navigation and the presentation title beat.

heading.description: Optional supporting explanation shown with the page.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) page introduction: what, why and next; used by the presentation title beat.

Page.description: One authored page with one main visual or activity and supporting text. Present may explain it through several automatic scenes.

what.description: What this section shows, in one sentence.

why.description: Why it matters to the learner.

next.description: What the learner should do or look for next.

Lead.description: Short lead-in shown above a section: what it shows, why it matters, and what comes next.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

what.description: IntroWhat(...) panel: what the topic is.

roadmap.description: Optional preview of the sections ahead, as RoadmapStep references.

estimatedTime.description: Optional time to complete, e.g. "25 min".

moduleCount.description: Optional number of modules shown in the header.

displayTitle.description: Optional title shown inside the card instead of `title`.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

Intro.description: Topic opener: what it is, why it matters, and a roadmap of the sections ahead. `displayTitle` overrides the title shown inside the card.

IntroWhat.description: The "what is it" panel of a topic intro.

summary.description: One-paragraph answer to "why does it matter?".

IntroWhy.description: The "why it matters" panel of a topic intro.

title.description: Name of the upcoming section.

type.description: Section type it previews, e.g. "quiz" or "flowchart".

description.description: What the learner will do there.

sectionId.description: Optional section file name (without .oui) to link to.

RoadmapStep.description: A roadmap entry previewing a later section. `type` is the section type (e.g. "quiz"); `sectionId` its file name.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

ordered.description: Optional: true numbers a linear procedure or ordered instructions; false keeps bullet points.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

Bullets.description: Linear instructions, prerequisites, checklists, key points and summaries; set `ordered` true for numbered procedures.

text.description: Bullet text. Wrap any phrase in **double asterisks** to make it bold, in both top-level and nested bullets (Read and Present).

children.description: Optional nested bullets, as Bullet calls.

icon.description: Optional meaningful icon: list, check, shield, clock, key, lightbulb, target, users, chart, code. Present groups points into pages that fit the stage; sub-items remain visibly nested.

Bullet.description: A bullet point, optionally with nested child bullets.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

TaxonomyBrowser.description: Introduce and explore meaningful categories with defining features, examples, scope and distinctions. Explain overlaps when relevant; browsing alone is not classification evidence.

title.description: Category name shown on the card.

icon.description: lucide-react icon name, e.g. "Brain" (falls back to a circle).

color.description: Accent colour: blue, peach, pink, mauve, green, teal, sky, lavender, yellow or red.

description.description: Summary shown on the card.

details.description: Explanation with examples, distinguishing features and any overlapping scope, shown in the category details.

primaryFocus.description: The main concern of this category, in one line.

outOfScope.description: What does not belong here (and often where it goes instead).

TaxonomyCategory.description: A category card in a taxonomy browser. `color` is a theme color name (e.g. "blue", "mauve").

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

images.description: The images, as GalleryImage references, in order.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

id.description: Image ID, unique within the gallery.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

layers.description: The rows, top to bottom, as Layer references.

blocks.description: Blocks placed on the grid, as MatrixBlock references. Together they must fill the grid without gaps.

description.description: Optional summary shown above the map; say what the reader should take away from the stack.

displayTitle.description: Optional title shown inside the map instead of `title`.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

PillarLayer.description: Layer-stack map: layers as rows (foundation last), blocks placed on a gap-free grid. Give blocks `dependsOn` so readers can tap a block to trace what it needs and what it affects. `displayTitle` overrides the title shown inside the map.

id.description: Layer ID, unique within the map; blocks refer to it with `layer`.

title.description: Layer name shown at the start of the row.

description.description: Optional layer summary.

items.description: Optional items listed for this layer, as LayerItem references.

Layer.description: A horizontal layer (row) of a pillar/layer matrix.

title.description: Item name.

description.description: Optional detail.

LayerItem.description: A labelled item listed inside a layer.

id.description: Block ID, unique within the map; `dependsOn` refers to it.

title.description: Text shown on the block.

layer.description: Anchor row: Layer reference or ID.

rowSpan.description: Optional number of rows covered, downward (default 1).

description.description: Optional detail shown when the block is selected.

color.description: Optional accent: rosewater, flamingo, pink, mauve, red, maroon, peach, yellow, green, teal, sky, sapphire, blue or lavender.

dependsOn.description: Optional IDs of blocks this block depends on.

shape.description: Optional "rect" (default) or an L-shape inside the span: "l-bottom-left", "l-bottom-right", "l-top-left", "l-top-right".

offsets.description: Optional custom shape: [rowOffset, colOffset] cells relative to the anchor. Overrides spans and shape.

group.description: Optional named outer container in Present mode. Blocks with the same group within a single-row layer share a box; different groups sit side by side.

MatrixBlock.description: A block placed on the matrix, anchored at `layer` (reference or ID) and `colOffset`. Spans default to 1; `shape` is "rect" or an L-shape. `dependsOn` lists block IDs.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

person.description: Person or role experiencing the journey.

stages.description: Ordered JourneyStage references. Works for physical products, software and services.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

UserJourney.description: A person’s experience across product or service stages. Read explores stages; Present walks goals, actions, responses and optional friction and outcomes without an Event Storming diagram.

name.description: Short stage name used in the journey rail.

goal.description: What the person wants to accomplish in this stage.

response.description: What the product, service or staff visibly does in response.

friction.description: Optional difficulty or unmet need; do not invent research findings.

recovery.description: Optional way to address the authored friction; requires friction.

outcome.description: Optional resulting state or next step; do not assume success.

JourneyStage.description: One stage of a person’s experience: their goal, action, product response, and optional friction, recovery and outcome.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

lanes.description: Participant or resource metadata for task labels and colors; task rows are ordered automatically by start time.

activities.description: Timed activities; bars use one shared scale across all lanes.

groups.description: Optional ordered presentation groups; cover every activity. Without groups, activities sharing a start time are explained together.

unit.description: Time unit for every start and duration; default "ms". Use a consistent unit.

description.description: Optional context, including whether timing is measured or illustrative.

takeaway.description: Optional conclusion shown on the final summary beat.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

Timeline.description: Measured task timeline: one row per activity, sorted by start time, with duration-scaled bars, parallel work and finish-to-start dependencies. Present keeps the whole diagram visible while focusing authored groups.

id.description: Lane ID, unique within the timeline.

title.description: Readable lane name.

color.description: Optional theme accent for the lane and its activities.

TimelineLane.description: A named participant or resource used as a task’s secondary label and color. Each task gets its own row.

id.description: Activity ID, unique within the timeline.

title.description: Short readable activity name.

start.description: Elapsed start time from zero, in the timeline unit.

duration.description: Duration in the same unit; zero is a milestone.

description.description: Optional explanation shown on selection in Read mode.

dependsOn.description: Optional activity IDs that must finish before this activity starts; draws dependency connectors.

TimelineActivity.description: Activity positioned by elapsed start time and duration; zero duration represents a milestone.

id.description: Group ID, unique within the timeline.

title.description: Short stage name shown in Present.

activities.description: Activities to highlight together, as references or IDs; include parallel activities in one group.

description.description: Optional explanation of what this stage means.

TimelineGroup.description: Activities explained together on one presentation beat, including parallel work or a join.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

nodes.description: All nodes, with one root and parent IDs linking every other node to it.

mode.description: Optional "quantity" (default): children sum to their parent; "probability": each sibling set sums to 1 and path probabilities multiply.

unit.description: One unit for all quantities, such as USD, grams or requests; leave empty in probability mode.

description.description: Optional context, source and assumptions; label constructed figures as illustrative.

takeaway.description: Optional conclusion shown on the final summary beat.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

BreakdownTree.description: A whole divided into measurable parts: costs, counts, time allocation or conditional probability. Calculates each part’s share of its parent and the whole, validates totals, and explains one split per presentation beat.

id.description: Node ID, unique within this tree.

title.description: Short name for this part.

value.description: Quantity in the shared unit, or a conditional probability from 0 to 1 in probability mode; root probability is 1.

parent.description: Optional parent node ID; exactly one node omits parent and becomes the root.

description.description: Optional explanation for Read details and narration.

color.description: Optional theme accent for the node; descendants inherit their parent accent unless overridden.

BreakdownNode.description: A named part of a measurable whole; parent IDs define the hierarchy.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

actors.description: Human actors, as Actor references. Each must start at least one step.

systems.description: Systems, as System references. Each must handle or receive at least one step.

steps.description: The flow, as Step and Branch references, in order.

journeys.description: Guided paths through the flow, as Journey references.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

initialView.description: Optional view the section opens on: "event-storming" (default), "architecture", "swimlanes", "sequence", "data-flow" or "state-machine" (needs a system with a StateMachine). Pick the one that shows the lesson best.

Flowchart.description: Animated Event Storming flowchart. Every actor and system must be used by at least one step.

id.description: Actor ID, unique within the flowchart; steps refer to it with `initiatedBy`.

title.description: Actor name shown on its sticky (e.g. "Buyer").

desc.description: What this actor is or wants.

Actor.description: A human actor (user role) who initiates steps.

id.description: System ID, unique within the flowchart; steps refer to it with `handledBy` / `delegatesTo`.

title.description: System name shown on its sticky (e.g. "Order Service").

desc.description: What the system owns or does.

kind.description: Optional "aggregate" (owned domain model), "service" (owned component without its own domain model), "database" (data store) or "external" (outside system). Default "external".

stateMachine.description: Optional StateMachine(...) for a system that orchestrates the flow.

System.description: A system that handles commands: an "aggregate" (owned domain model) or an "external" service.

StateMachine.description: State machine for an orchestrating system. `initialState` is a state ID.

id.description: State ID, unique within the state machine.

label.description: State name shown in the state machine view.

color.description: CSS colour for the state, e.g. "var(--ctp-green)" or "#a6d189".

MachineState.description: A state of a system state machine.

id.description: Step ID, unique within the flowchart; journeys and `continuesAs` refer to it.

policy.description: Policy that reacts to the incoming event ("When …"); the POLICY sticky.

command.description: Command the policy issues, in imperative form (e.g. "PlaceOrder").

handledBy.description: System that handles the command (System reference or ID).

events.description: Events the handler emits, as Event references (past tense).

initiatedBy.description: Optional actor that starts this path (Actor reference or ID), usually on the first step.

delegatesTo.description: Optional second system the handler calls (System reference or ID).

continuesAs.description: Optional ID of the Step, Branch or BranchOption that this path's events lead into.

description.description: Optional narration of this step, shown when it is highlighted.

sendsTo.description: Optional actor or system that receives this step's events (e.g. the server sends ServerHello to the client).

async.description: Optional: true when the command is sent without waiting for a reply (fire-and-forget); the Sequence view draws it with an open arrowhead.

Step.description: Linear Event Storming step: POLICY → COMMAND → handledBy system → resulting events. `initiatedBy` is the actor that starts it; `delegatesTo` a system the handler calls; `sendsTo` the actor or system that receives its events.

id.description: Event ID, unique within the flowchart.

title.description: Event name in past tense (e.g. "Order Placed").

enters.description: Optional MachineState ID the state machine enters when this event happens; the State Machine view draws its transitions from these.

data.description: Optional description of the data the event carries (e.g. "Order ID, total, line items"); the Data Flow view names the data object with it instead of the event title.

Event.description: A domain event produced by a step (past tense, e.g. "Order Placed").

id.description: Branch ID, unique within the flowchart.

event.description: The event that splits into the options (e.g. "Payment Checked").

Branch.description: Branching step: one event splits into several policy/command paths.

id.description: Option ID, unique within the flowchart; journeys and `continuesAs` refer to it.

label.description: Label drawn on the branch edge (e.g. "approved").

policy.description: Policy that reacts to the incoming event ("When …"); the POLICY sticky.

command.description: Command the policy issues, in imperative form (e.g. "PlaceOrder").

handledBy.description: System that handles the command (System reference or ID).

events.description: Events the handler emits, as Event references (past tense).

dashed.description: Optional: true draws this path as a dashed line (e.g. an error path).

initiatedBy.description: Optional actor that starts this path (Actor reference or ID), usually on the first step.

delegatesTo.description: Optional second system the handler calls (System reference or ID).

continuesAs.description: Optional ID of the Step, Branch or BranchOption that this path's events lead into.

description.description: Optional narration of this step, shown when it is highlighted.

sendsTo.description: Optional actor or system that receives this step's events (e.g. the server sends ServerHello to the client).

async.description: Optional: true when the command is sent without waiting for a reply (fire-and-forget); the Sequence view draws it with an open arrowhead.

BranchOption.description: One path of a branch: label, then the same POLICY → COMMAND → system → events cycle as a Step.

id.description: Journey ID, unique within the flowchart.

label.description: Journey name shown in the journey picker (e.g. "Happy path").

description.description: What this journey walks through.

steps.description: The stops in order, as JourneyStep references.

Journey.description: A guided path through the flow, from start to finish.

step.description: The Step or BranchOption this stop plays (reference or ID).

name.description: Short stop name shown in the journey list.

description.description: Narration shown while the stop is played.

processGroup.description: Optional free-text phase label for the stop (e.g. "planning", "handshake"); the state-machine state comes from Event `enters`, not from this.

JourneyStep.description: A stop on a journey: the Step or BranchOption it plays (reference or ID), with a short name and narration. `processGroup` is an optional phase label for the stop (e.g. "planning", "handshake").

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

id.description: Scenario ID, unique within the topic.

intro.description: Optional setup text shown before the first node.

startNode.description: Optional ID of the first node (default "start").

displayTitle.description: Optional title shown inside the scenario instead of `title`.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

Scenario.description: Branching "what would you do?" scenario. `startNode` defaults to "start". `displayTitle` overrides the title shown inside the scenario.

id.description: Node ID, unique within the scenario; choices point at it with `next`.

prompt.description: Situation and question shown at this node (prompt nodes).

outcome.description: Outcome(...) ending (outcome nodes, instead of prompt/choices).

ScenarioNode.description: A scenario node: a prompt with choices, or an outcome.

id.description: Choice ID, unique within its node.

text.description: Choice text shown on the button.

next.description: ID of the ScenarioNode this choice leads to.

ScenarioChoice.description: A choice in a scenario. `next` is the ID of the node it leads to.

verdict.description: Short judgement of the path taken (e.g. "Solid call").

lesson.description: What the learner should take away.

Outcome.description: End of a scenario path: verdict, lesson, and rating ("a", "b-plus", "b-minus" or "c").

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

TradeoffSandbox.description: Explained comparison of alternatives across shared criteria, strengths, limitations and consequences. Use for comparison even without a decision request; contextual situations and recommendations are optional. Qualitative comparisons use empty metrics; avoid invented scores or a universal winner.

id.description: Scenario ID, unique within the sandbox.

title.description: Scenario name shown in the scenario picker.

metrics.description: Metrics to watch, as TradeoffMetric references; use [] for a qualitative comparison.

steps.description: Comparison criteria or decisions in order, as TradeoffStep references.

description.description: Optional scenario summary.

TradeoffScenario.description: A general comparison container or a contextual situation, with comparison criteria or decisions to explore.

id.description: Metric ID, unique within the scenario; choices refer to it in `metrics`.

label.description: Metric name shown on its bar (e.g. "Latency").

baseValue.description: Starting value before any choice is made.

min.description: Optional lowest value the bar shows (default 0).

max.description: Optional highest value the bar shows (default 100).

direction.description: Optional "higher" or "lower": which way is better.

TradeoffMetric.description: A metric tracked across a trade-off scenario. `direction` says whether higher or lower is better.

id.description: Step ID, unique within the scenario.

title.description: The shared comparison criterion or decision to explore at this step.

description.description: Optional explanation of the comparison criterion or decision context.

recommended.description: Optional ID of the recommended choice.

TradeoffStep.description: One comparison criterion or decision point. Reuse alternatives across criteria; recommended is optional.

id.description: Choice ID, unique within the step; `recommended` refers to it.

label.description: Option name shown on the choice card.

description.description: What picking this option means.

metrics.description: Delta per metric ID when picked; use {} for a qualitative comparison without scores.

whyThisFits.description: Optional reason this option fits the scenario.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when to choose this option in practice.

TradeoffChoice.description: One option in a trade-off step. `metrics` maps metric IDs to the delta this choice applies, e.g. {performance: 10, cost: -5}.

title.description: Short pro or con statement.

description.description: Optional detail behind the statement.

ProCon.description: A pro or con of a trade-off choice.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

FormulaSandbox.description: Parameter sandbox: sliders drive live formula-based metrics.

id.description: Variable ID, used by name inside formulas (letters, digits, _).

FormulaVariable.description: A slider input that formulas can reference by `id`.

id.description: Metric ID, unique within the sandbox.

label.description: Metric name shown on its card.

formula.description: JavaScript expression over variable IDs, e.g. "Math.round(chunk_size * (1 + overlap / 70))".

description.description: What the metric measures.

analogy.description: Optional everyday analogy shown in the metric details.

inScope.description: Optional list of what the metric covers.

outOfScope.description: Optional list of what the metric does not cover.

FormulaMetric.description: A computed metric. `formula` is an expression over variable IDs, e.g. "Math.round(chunk_size * (1 + overlap / 70))".

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

id.description: Tree ID, unique within the topic.

displayTitle.description: Optional title shown inside the guide instead of `title`.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

DecisionTree.description: Interactive decision guide. `root` is the ID of the first node. `displayTitle` overrides the title shown inside the guide.

id.description: Node ID, unique within the tree; choices point at it with `next`.

prompt.description: Question asked at this node (question nodes).

leaf.description: DecisionLeaf(...) recommendation (leaf nodes, instead of prompt/choices).

DecisionNode.description: A decision tree node: either a question with choices, or a leaf recommendation.

id.description: Choice ID, unique within its node.

text.description: Answer text shown on the button.

next.description: ID of the DecisionNode this answer leads to.

rationale.description: Optional reason for taking this branch.

recommended.description: Optional: true highlights this answer as recommended.

DecisionChoice.description: An answer that moves to another decision node. `next` is the target node ID.

recommendation.description: The recommended option at the end of this path.

tradeoffs.description: Optional list of trade-offs to keep in mind.

DecisionLeaf.description: Terminal recommendation of a decision tree.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

challenges.description: The challenges, as SequenceChallenge references, in order.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

ReflectionSequence.description: Sequence-builder reflection: learners put steps in the right order.

prompt.description: Instruction shown above the items, e.g. "Put the steps in order".

items.description: The items to order, as SequenceItem references, in the order they are first shown (not the solution order).

solution.description: The same items (references or IDs) in the correct order.

SequenceChallenge.description: Ask the learner to order items. `solution` lists the items (references or IDs) in the correct order.

id.description: Item ID, unique within the challenge; `solution` refers to it.

text.description: Text shown on the draggable card.

icon.description: Optional icon name (reserved; not shown yet).

SequenceItem.description: A draggable item in a sequence challenge.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

challenges.description: The challenges, as TemplateChallenge references, in order.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

ReflectionTemplate.description: Self-explanation reflection: learners complete sentence templates with chips.

template.description: Sentence with {zone-id} blanks, e.g. "A cache trades {zone-1} for {zone-2}."

chips.description: Chips the learner can drop into blanks, as Chip references (may include distractors).

solution.description: Correct chip per blank: an object of zone ID → chip ID, e.g. {"zone-1": "chip-a"}.

explanation.description: Optional explanation shown once the template is solved.

TemplateChallenge.description: Fill-in-the-blanks self-explanation. `template` contains {zone-id} slots; `solution` maps each zone ID to a chip ID, e.g. {"zone-1": "chip-a"}.

id.description: Chip ID, unique within the challenge; `solution` refers to it.

text.description: Word or phrase shown on the chip.

Chip.description: A word chip the learner drops into a template blank.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

questions.description: The questions, as QuizQuestion references, in order.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

id.description: Question ID, unique within the quiz.

choices.description: Answer options, as QuizChoice references. Exactly one is correct.

hint.description: Optional hint the learner can reveal before answering.

QuizQuestion.description: A multiple-choice question. Mark exactly one choice as correct.

id.description: Choice ID, unique within its question (e.g. "a").

text.description: Answer text shown on the option button.

correct.description: true for the one correct choice of the question.

explanation.description: Feedback shown after this choice is picked: why it is right or wrong.

QuizChoice.description: One answer option of a quiz question, with the explanation shown after answering.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

cards.description: The cards, as Flashcard references, in deck order.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

Flashcards.description: Introduce individual concepts and meanings, then practise recall with focused explanation cards. Examples and dialogue can clarify meaning; a flip records exposure, not correctness.

id.description: Card ID, unique within the deck.

word.description: One focused term or question on the front of the card.

pronunciation.description: How to say the term, e.g. "/ˈkæʃ/".

category.description: Grouping shown as a badge on the card (e.g. "concept").

shortDefinition.description: One-line definition shown on the back.

detailedDefinition.description: A coherent explanation shown on the back, with a concise example or common mistake when useful.

whyItMatters.description: Why the learner should care about this term.

image.description: Optional image source; check contracts/images.md and the current MCP runtime resource policy before using a URL or data URI.

dialogue.description: Optional Dialogue(...) example that shows the term in use.

Flashcard.description: One focused term or question on the front and a coherent explanation on the back, for introduction or recall.

user.description: What the user says, using the term.

aiThoughts.description: The AI's internal reasoning about the user's message.

aiQuestion.description: The follow-up question the AI asks back.

Dialogue.description: Example exchange showing a term in use: what the user says, what the AI thinks, and its follow-up question.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

links.description: The edges between concepts, as ConceptLink references.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

ConceptMap.description: Knowledge graph of concepts and the relations between them.

id.description: Concept ID, unique within the map; links point at it.

title.description: Label shown on the node.

category.description: Optional node colour group: pattern, mechanism, concept, role, system, data or process.

Concept.description: A node in a concept map.

label.description: A short verb phrase that makes from + label + to a meaningful statement, e.g. "uses", "is a", "contains" or "depends on". Present explains each relation in this authored direction; do not imply causality or data flow unless that is what the label means. An omitted label is shown neutrally as "is connected to".

ConceptLink.description: A labelled relation between two concepts (references or concept IDs).

title.description: Topic title shown in the catalog and topic header.

category.description: Catalog group the topic is listed under.

description.description: One- or two-sentence summary shown on the catalog card.

sections.description: The sections in reading order, as SectionRef calls.

tags.description: Optional keyword tags for search and filtering.

isNew.description: Optional: true shows a "new" badge in the catalog.

Topic.description: Topic manifest (root of topic.oui): catalog metadata and the ordered list of sections.

name.description: Section file name without .oui, e.g. "intro" for sections/intro.oui.

SectionRef.description: Includes the section file sections/<name>.oui of this topic.

topics.description: The topics in catalog order, as TopicRef calls.

Catalog.description: Content catalog (root of index.oui): the ordered list of topics.

id.description: Topic folder name under the content root.

TopicRef.description: Includes the topic folder <id>/topic.oui in the catalog.

title.description: Domain name shown to the learner (e.g. "Fight Animation"); topics in it use it as their category.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the domain covers.

topics.description: Its topics in suggested learning order, as TopicRef calls naming files in topics/ (TopicRef("punch-basics") for topics/punch-basics.loom.oui).

goal.description: Optional: what the learner wants to reach in this domain, in their words (e.g. "animate a 10-second fight scene in Blender").

Domain.description: A learner's subject area (root of Loom/<domain-id>/domain.oui): its title, its topics in suggested learning order and the learner's goal.

id.description: Domain ID: the folder name under Loom/, lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (e.g. "fight-animation").

DomainRef.description: Includes the domain folder Loom/<id>/ (its domain.oui) in the library.

domains.description: The domains, as DomainRef calls, most recently studied first.

Library.description: The learner's library (root of Loom/index.oui): the list of their domains.

steps.description: The narrated steps in order, as NarrationStep references.

Narration.description: Root of a narration file sections/<name>.narrate.oui: the script Present mode plays the section to, step by step.

beat.description: The beat it plays on, by its ID for the section type, e.g. "q1", "q1.wrong", "q1.right" for a quiz, "p2" for a text paragraph (see Narration Files).

caption.description: Subtitle line shown and read aloud while the beat plays, in the topic's language; null for none.

effects.description: Highlight, NarrationCallout and Spotlight calls for the step.

view.description: For flowcharts, optionally switch to this view while this narration step plays; null keeps the flowchart’s initial view.

NarrationStep.description: One narrated step: the beat it plays on, a caption line read aloud, and effects. Several steps on one beat play in turn.

target.description: Pick pointer to what it points at in the section file: a statement name, optionally with a prop path, e.g. "noCache", "q2.explanation", "root.categories[0]".

Highlight.description: Narration effect: outlines and pulses one element of the section for its step.

target.description: Pick pointer to what it points at in the section file: a statement name, optionally with a prop path, e.g. "noCache", "q2.explanation", "root.categories[0]".

text.description: The note, one or two short sentences. Narration reads it after the caption.

NarrationCallout.description: Narration effect: a note that pops up beside one element of the section, with explanation the section does not say itself.

targets.description: Pick pointers of the elements to frame together, e.g. ["noCache", "noStore"].

Spotlight.description: Narration effect: the camera moves in on these elements and dims the rest of the section.
